notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites: There is at least one card in your library.
description:
Pay {1}{U} to turn Coveted Falcon face up, drawing a card and causing target opponent to gain control of Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
